pack: Suno + REAPER candidate pack (REAPER lab run v03-full-candidate-2026-11-02)
collaboration: Coda built the REAPER lab, the v02 cuts, the production plan and the reviewed cue contract; Red generated the remaining Suno takes, selected and verified cuts, rendered natively in REAPER and integrated.
listening_status: Nobody has heard these files. Black lines are ASR-verified (base.en, small.en, medium.en on the final files); Sulgogar calls are signal- and spectrogram-selected with a per-slot confidence. Auditory and in-game acceptance remain with Andrei.
level_policy: -18 LUFS routine / -17 LUFS for Sulgogar events whose duration target starts at 0.8 s, true peak <= -3.5 dBFS before export, gain capped at +12 dB (three quiet Sulgogar calls stay below target).
black_voice: Suno v6 (Songs Advanced, spoken word, male) takes separated with Demucs htdemucs vocal stems; four lines are Coda v02 cuts of her own Suno vocal estimates.
sulg_provenance: Suno v6 creature-call takes used unseparated; three Coda v02 salvage fragments kept.

render.method: Native REAPER 7.79 render through the TwelveTake bridge; per-cue sample windows cut by cue_export.finalize; ffmpeg pan/resample to PCM16 mono 22050 Hz.

previous: Version 3 (Microsoft David SAPI Black Sect, procedural Sulgogars) remains on red/review-fixes and in history.
